描述_EN: star wars: a new hope was released in 1977. sequels released in 1980 and 1983 were equally successful. queen amidala first appears in the 1999 film, 'episode 1: the phantom menace' as the young queen of the planet naboo. the first film of george lucas' trilogies was the most successful in american history and grossed over $290 million. a whole host of toy figures, spacecrafts and toy guns were available, as well as costumes, stationery, bedroom accessories and slippers. the films captured their imagination and paved the way for the merchandising that accompanies many films today.
描述_ZN: 《星球大战：新希望》于1977年上映。 1980年和1983年发行的续集同样成功。 阿米达拉女王第一次出现在1999年的电影《第一集：幽灵的威胁》中，作为纳布星球的年轻女王。 乔治-卢卡斯的三部曲中的第一部电影是美国历史上最成功的，总票房超过2.9亿美元。 一大堆的玩具人物、太空飞船和玩具枪，以及服装、文具、卧室配件和拖鞋。 这些电影抓住了他们的想象力，为今天许多电影的商品销售铺平了道路。
